name: Decision Tick - Decided Read Only
description: What the wider team sees on a decided decision: the answer and who gave it, with no controls at all. Worth capturing separately from the signed-in view because the read-only path is a different branch rather than the same markup with disabled buttons — and because this is the view that matters most for the page's actual purpose. The point of committing an answer is that everyone can read it; being able to change it is the narrower privilege.
